steps.note: Every eligible ClinicalTrials.gov record — the registry, not every trial ever run.

Phase 1/2 counts as Phase 2; Phase 2/3 counts as Phase 3.
Start date, not registration date. The window ends three years back so trials have had time to close.
The rate's denominator. Withdrawn (never enrolled), suspended, ongoing and unknown-status trials are excluded because their outcome is not yet observed.
